about.title: About me
about.bio: I'm a back-end developer focused on Java and Spring Boot. At Capgemini, I build and maintain REST APIs for the insurance sector, integrate legacy mainframe systems (IBM ACE, CICS) and modernize applications from Java 7/8 to Java 21. I work from requirements refinement to production, with automated tests and microservices.

quote.text: Make it work, make it right, make it fast.
quote.author: Kent Beck

capgemini.description: Backend consultant for Bradesco Seguros, Brazil's leading insurance provider, modernizing legacy mainframe systems and sustaining REST APIs in production.
bullets: Worked with client Bradesco Seguros using Java, Spring Boot and IBM ACE, including integrations with CICS and legacy mainframe systems.
Followed projects end-to-end, from requirements refinement to production delivery, tracking scope, deadlines and risks.
Built new features and maintained REST APIs, proposing technical solutions aligned with the client's business goals.
Modernized legacy systems, migrating applications from Java 7/8 (WebSphere) to Java 21 with Spring Boot.
Implemented mainframe integrations via IBM ACE, CICS program calls and SOAP services, ensuring interoperability between legacy and modern systems.
Investigated and resolved incidents and bugs across DSV, HML and PRD environments, improving service stability and resilience.
Wrote automated tests with JUnit and Mockito, plus endpoint validation with Postman, increasing coverage and delivery reliability.
Documented APIs with SpringDoc/OpenAPI and maintained Confluence pages for knowledge standardization and sharing.

avanade.description: Junior developer maintaining and evolving backend and frontend applications for enterprise clients.
bullets: Maintained and supported backend code, ensuring application stability and evolution.
Maintained and supported frontend code, contributing to bug fixes and feature improvements.
Fixed bugs across backend and frontend applications, ensuring quality and reliability.
Implemented new features on both backend and frontend, following defined requirements.
Used Java and Spring Boot on the backend, and TypeScript with Angular on the frontend.

compassuol.description: Backend-focused internship applying Java, Spring Boot and cloud fundamentals in a collaborative, distributed team.
bullets: Studied and applied Java and Spring Boot in backend application development.
Got a hands-on introduction to microservices architecture, service communication and best practices.
Worked with AWS services, learning cloud computing concepts and distributed environments.
Collaborated in a team environment, strengthening communication and organization skills.

payflow.summary: Payments API that processes Pix and card charges, with automatic reconciliation and idempotent webhooks.
overview: I built a payments API so merchants can take Pix and card payments without integrating each acquirer. Every charge runs through a state machine, and reconciliation runs on its own at the end of the day.
Webhooks are idempotent and retried with exponential backoff through Kafka, so no event is lost when a client goes down.
shots: OpenAPI docs for the charge endpoints

catalog.summary: Video catalog microservice in Clean Architecture, with asynchronous uploads and encoding events.
overview: A microservice that manages a video platform's catalog: categories, genres, cast members and videos.
The domain stays free of frameworks. Uploads go through RabbitMQ to the encoder, and integration tests run against a real MySQL with Testcontainers.

notify.summary: Central notification service for email, SMS and push, with versioned templates and per-client send limits.
overview: A service that brings all of the company's notifications into one place, with versioned templates and per-user preferences.
A Redis rate limit protects the providers, and messages flow through SQS queues to absorb spikes.
